sentences.en: He negotiated the divestment of several of these, including agrochemicals and fine chemicals.

sentences.en: Given that this transaction concerns the acquisition of a single depot, the OFT does not believe that divestment undertakings would be appropriate.

sentences.en: The actions today were part of a concerted campaign calling for boycott, divestment and sanctions against apartheid Israel.

sentences.en: Not all signatories of the divestment petition are siding with either camp.
